propositions: not_a_bug close without replacement link falls through to completion verifier, which demands proof of a fixed defect, making truthful not_a_bug closes impossible without --force
close_disposition.verdict() returns None for not_a_bug (no replacement found) and routes to full completion verification, which asks the wrong question for a class that asserts no defect existed
not_a_bug and escalated must become REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so verdict() mints a deterministic attestation from (class, close_reason) without invoking the completion verifier
a live replacement link must be checked first in verdict() and still short-circuit the reason requirement for not_a_bug and escalated (REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES)
not_a_bug or escalated close without both reason and replacement link must be refused at write time via txn.close_class_refusal, never falling through to the completion verifier
